newsitem.title: USA: ICN says virazole approved for reimbursement.
newsitem.headline: ICN says virazole approved for reimbursement.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesday its antiviral virazole (ribavirin) capsules have been approved for government reimbursement by the Mexican Federal Health Authorities.
The company said about 20 million patients in government-operated medical clinics in Mexico are eligible for reimbursement under the country's social security system.
It said virazole is approved for marketing in Mexico for a number of viral infections, including herpes genitalis zoster and labialis viral hepatitis, which includes hepatitis B and C; and AIDS.
ICN said the new government reimbursement program covers 400 milligram capsules of virazole.
